author: Дмитрий Лукашов
scope: Standalone offline process kit and Python CLI for proposed personal commitments from supplied meeting notes: exact quote/speaker checks, explicit full human-review records bound to source/candidate bytes, and deterministic local accepted-task CSV. No automatic extraction, LLM/API, source retrieval, identity authentication, messaging, live task creation, completeness or semantic commitment/deadline verification; not a general orchestration engine.
origin: Original note-span checking/export workflow, bilingual docs/runbook and invented teaching inputs prepared for this standalone public-module task in November2026 with AI assistance. Install/uninstall helpers adapt the same author public MIT CRM RevOps Kit v0.1.0 helpers with authorship and rights retained. No private core, real transcript, company workspace, client notes, proprietary workflow or third-party skill collection copied.
output_format: JSON technical review and export readback; UTF8/LF accepted task CSV

input_limits.schema: Run schema for exact required fields, bounded strings/spans and semantic constraints. Explicit module format, not arbitrary transcript/CRM import.

installer_support: POSIX explicit-prefix launcher; Windows source CLI. CI configuration and actual native-host outcomes are separate evidence.

search_intent.ru: реестр задач из заметок встречи; проверка цитат и ответственных; экспорт задач после проверки человеком
search_intent.en: meeting notes to reviewed action register; source span checks; human-reviewed task CSV export

suggested_description: Turn supplied meeting-note action candidates into a reviewed local task CSV. Exact source spans, version-bound human decisions and complete-batch export checks. Offline Python, no model or live task writes.
